$comment: Implementation details for Havenot-Settings-Library.json (a second library, another schema; the source stays untouched). It fills what the source leaves undefined: the floor, wall and light tiles its rooms name (their ids describe them), the rooms' real fixtures (the source has 'Primary <room> fixture'), each shared furniture piece's home setting, the per-setting decay hazards, and dressing. 'extends' takes the drawing families, clusters, hazard behaviours, device kinds and loot rules of library 1's companion; rules here are tried first.

materials.$comment: Matched against each tile's description, which is its id in words (FLOOR_BLOOD_GLASS: 'blood glass').

room_archetypes.$comment: The source's 20 room templates (a room's name before ' - ') and what each really holds: its two required fixtures (the source has 'Primary <room> fixture' and one setting-specific piece, which is kept as the second), optional pieces, and its cluster.

shared_furniture.$comment: Each shared furniture record's object name and home setting. In a room of its home setting it's ordinary furniture; elsewhere it's the deliberate mismatch pool (the source's pools mix settings).

conditions.$comment: A room's current_condition, as history: an overlay and a state (0 intact, 1 worn, 2 ruined).

archetypes.$comment: Extra drawing-family rules for this library's names, tried before library 1's.

decay_hazards.$comment: The source's HAZ_<setting>_DECAY records don't exist. Each is written here from the setting's decay_patterns and security_character. The name picks a behaviour (packs/hn-gen-kit/hazards.js, library 1's rules); severity scales with the floor's Threat Level, no JAGS numbers.

SET_MARTYRDOM_CARNIVAL.name: congealed blood spill
SET_MARTYRDOM_CARNIVAL.clues: a floor gone the texture of chewing gum, melted wax figures sunk in it, a scoreboard stuck on 9.8
SET_MARTYRDOM_CARNIVAL.effect: the floor grips and burns; slow going while the animatronics sob
SET_MARTYRDOM_CARNIVAL.countermeasure: the drain valve at the booth, or go round the edge

SET_IDENTITY_LAUNDROMAT.name: identity slurry flood
SET_IDENTITY_LAUNDROMAT.trigger: the basement drains backing up when a machine runs
SET_IDENTITY_LAUNDROMAT.clues: a tide line of mixed-up faces on the walls, static cling hair on end
SET_IDENTITY_LAUNDROMAT.effect: liquid identities wash in; it stings and it whispers
SET_IDENTITY_LAUNDROMAT.countermeasure: shut off the wash cycle at the controls, or keep to high ground

SET_AD_CATHEDRAL.name: jingle loop broadcast
SET_AD_CATHEDRAL.trigger: standing in a speaker's sight line
SET_AD_CATHEDRAL.clues: a jingle stuck on half a word, taxidermied mascots facing one way
SET_AD_CATHEDRAL.effect: the half-word loops in your head until you can't think straight
SET_AD_CATHEDRAL.countermeasure: cut the choir loft's power, or plug your ears and walk fast

SET_WEAPON_RETIREMENT.name: senile sentry turret
SET_WEAPON_RETIREMENT.trigger: being young, loud, or on its lawn
SET_WEAPON_RETIREMENT.clues: coolant drool under a warhead, shell casings on the shuffleboard court, a voice telling kids to get off
SET_WEAPON_RETIREMENT.effect: friendly fire from something that has forgotten who its friends are
SET_WEAPON_RETIREMENT.countermeasure: the bingo caller's console stands it down, or keep behind cover

SET_PET_ATELIER.name: cracked growth vat leak
SET_PET_ATELIER.clues: puddles of growth medium, half-finished toys that raised themselves, an overflowing return bin
SET_PET_ATELIER.effect: growth medium mists out and makes everything it touches grow wrong
SET_PET_ATELIER.countermeasure: close the vat feed at its panel, or don't breathe near it

SET_AFTERLIFE_RESORT.name: cold-burning tiki fire
SET_AFTERLIFE_RESORT.clues: tiki torches that burn blue and frost the glass, ghosts buffering mid-wave
SET_AFTERLIFE_RESORT.effect: a fire that freezes; it hurts just the same
SET_AFTERLIFE_RESORT.countermeasure: douse the torch line at the cabana switch, or wait out the flare

SET_REPUTATION_RECYCLING.name: burst cringe pipe spray
SET_REPUTATION_RECYCLING.trigger: pressure building in the pulping lines
SET_REPUTATION_RECYCLING.clues: pipes weeping something embarrassing, reputation bricks crumbling into infamy
SET_REPUTATION_RECYCLING.effect: pure cringe sprays out; it eats at you and won't stop replaying
SET_REPUTATION_RECYCLING.countermeasure: the line's pressure valve, or keep moving through

SET_HAPPINESS_BUREAU.name: joy gas leak
SET_HAPPINESS_BUREAU.trigger: the morale system venting on schedule
SET_HAPPINESS_BUREAU.clues: smile posters peeling off terror posters, hysterical corpses that died laughing
SET_HAPPINESS_BUREAU.effect: joy gas: you laugh until you can't breathe
SET_HAPPINESS_BUREAU.countermeasure: shut the morale vents at the supervisor's desk, or hold your breath

SET_DREAM_TAX.name: escaped nightmare projection
SET_DREAM_TAX.trigger: falling asleep on your feet, or a feral dream noticing you
SET_DREAM_TAX.clues: tax forms folded into origami monsters, nests of unpaid dreams
SET_DREAM_TAX.effect: a nightmare plays out round you as though it were real
SET_DREAM_TAX.countermeasure: stamp it paid at an audit desk, or wake yourself up and run

SET_GOURMET_BUNKER.name: freezer cryogenic leak
SET_GOURMET_BUNKER.trigger: the cold store's door left ajar
SET_GOURMET_BUNKER.clues: frost round a freezer of VIPs still on ice, a reservation book that bleeds
SET_GOURMET_BUNKER.effect: cryogenic fog that freezes what it settles on
SET_GOURMET_BUNKER.countermeasure: close the freezer at its panel, or keep out of the fog

traps.$comment: The shared trap records have a name and nothing else. Their mechanics, written from their names; a room whose archetype is a trap room (below) gets its trap as its hazard instead of the setting's decay.

TRAP_CONFETTI_CANNON_LETHAL.name: confetti cannon volley
TRAP_CONFETTI_CANNON_LETHAL.clues: paper streamers with blades in them, a cannon on a gimbal
TRAP_CONFETTI_CANNON_LETHAL.countermeasure: the party switch, or keep low

TRAP_CRINGE_SPRAY.name: cringe spray
TRAP_CRINGE_SPRAY.trigger: a pressure plate under the welcome mat
TRAP_CRINGE_SPRAY.clues: nozzles in the ceiling tiles, a smell of secondhand embarrassment
TRAP_CRINGE_SPRAY.effect: a spray that won't stop replaying your worst moment
TRAP_CRINGE_SPRAY.countermeasure: close the line's valve, or run through

TRAP_DREAM_TAX_LIEN.name: dream tax lien seal
TRAP_DREAM_TAX_LIEN.clues: a notice of lien on the door, a stamp hanging over it
TRAP_DREAM_TAX_LIEN.effect: the room seals until the lien is paid
TRAP_DREAM_TAX_LIEN.countermeasure: pay at the audit desk, or override the door

TRAP_EXCOMMUNICATION_COUPON.name: brand-loyalty identity check
TRAP_EXCOMMUNICATION_COUPON.trigger: passing a cherub scanner without brand loyalty
TRAP_EXCOMMUNICATION_COUPON.clues: coupons for nothing in a drift on the floor, cherubs with lenses for eyes
TRAP_EXCOMMUNICATION_COUPON.effect: an excommunication broadcast straight into your head
TRAP_EXCOMMUNICATION_COUPON.countermeasure: show a blessed logo, or cut the broadcast

TRAP_FRIENDLY_FIRE_REMINISCENCE.name: friendly fire reminiscence turret
TRAP_FRIENDLY_FIRE_REMINISCENCE.trigger: a war story told within earshot
TRAP_FRIENDLY_FIRE_REMINISCENCE.clues: medals on a gun mount, a turret that hums old songs
TRAP_FRIENDLY_FIRE_REMINISCENCE.effect: it remembers the war and fires at it
TRAP_FRIENDLY_FIRE_REMINISCENCE.countermeasure: stand it down at its console, or stay out of its line

TRAP_MANDATORY_FUN_TICKET.name: mandatory fun euphoria
TRAP_MANDATORY_FUN_TICKET.trigger: insufficient enthusiasm near a ticket machine
TRAP_MANDATORY_FUN_TICKET.clues: a ticket dispenser that grins, enforced smiles on the dead
TRAP_MANDATORY_FUN_TICKET.effect: compulsory euphoria; you can't stop to think
TRAP_MANDATORY_FUN_TICKET.countermeasure: punch your ticket, or break the machine

TRAP_OVERBOOKED_AFTERLIFE.name: overbooked afterlife gate
TRAP_OVERBOOKED_AFTERLIFE.clues: a velvet rope, a sign saying FULL, a queue of ghosts
TRAP_OVERBOOKED_AFTERLIFE.effect: the gate shuts you in with the queue
TRAP_OVERBOOKED_AFTERLIFE.countermeasure: an afterlife voucher, or force the gate

TRAP_RETURN_BIN_TODDLERS.name: return-bin toddler automaton
TRAP_RETURN_BIN_TODDLERS.clues: a bin that giggles, small handprints on the inside of the lid
TRAP_RETURN_BIN_TODDLERS.effect: obsolete kids climb out and want to play
TRAP_RETURN_BIN_TODDLERS.countermeasure: close the bin and lock it, or offer them a toy

TRAP_SOMMELIER_JUDGMENT.name: sommelier bot judgment
TRAP_SOMMELIER_JUDGMENT.clues: a wine list with names of the dead, a bot with a corkscrew arm
TRAP_SOMMELIER_JUDGMENT.effect: the sommelier objects to your pairing, violently
TRAP_SOMMELIER_JUDGMENT.countermeasure: order correctly, or switch it off at the cellar

TRAP_STATIC_CLING_GHOST.name: static cling shock
TRAP_STATIC_CLING_GHOST.trigger: touching anything metal after crossing the carpet
TRAP_STATIC_CLING_GHOST.clues: socks stuck to the walls, a ghost made of lint
TRAP_STATIC_CLING_GHOST.effect: a charge builds and lets go through you
TRAP_STATIC_CLING_GHOST.countermeasure: ground yourself on the drain, or go barefoot

key_objects.$comment: KEY_<setting>_HEART: every room lists its setting's heart, which isn't defined. It's one thing per setting, so it's loot only in that setting's Power Core & Heart room.
key_objects.SET_WEAPON_RETIREMENT: the Home's last launch authorization key

hazards.$comment: Behaviours for this library's hazard names, tried before library 1's (whose ray rule would take 'spray' for a beam).

names.$comment: Readable names for ids whose words come out backwards (TREAS_TRUFFLE_SCREAMING); anything not here is its id in words.

device_uses.$comment: What each device is for (the source's interactive records all say 'Investigate, hack, bribe, or apologize to it', which is how you deal with one, not what it does). The panel reads 'A <device>, for <use>.'
device_uses.INT_BINGO_NUKE_CALLER: calling the numbers, and the launch codes, at weapons bingo
device_uses.INT_CONFESSIONAL_PRODUCT: confessing your brand disloyalties for a discount
device_uses.INT_CUTENESS_RAY: making anything adorable, whether it consents or not
device_uses.INT_DEATH_APPLAUSE_METER: scoring a death by the audience's applause
device_uses.INT_DREAM_EXTRACTION_HELMET: drawing off a sleeper's dreams for assessment
device_uses.INT_EULOGY_HOLOGRAM: delivering a sponsored eulogy for anyone, living or not
device_uses.INT_FROWN_SCANNER: catching frowns and issuing enthusiasm citations
device_uses.INT_GENE_CRISPR_LOOM: weaving custom genes into made-to-order pets and children
device_uses.INT_GIGGLE_GAS_SPRINKLER: keeping morale up with a fine mist of laughing gas
device_uses.INT_IDENTITY_BLEACH_VAT: washing a personality back to factory white
device_uses.INT_JINGLE_CHOIR_LOFT: singing the sponsors' jingles around the clock
device_uses.INT_MEAT_PRINTER_YOU: printing a steak from a sample of the diner
device_uses.INT_MEMORY_POOL_FILTER: filtering painful memories out of the resort pool
device_uses.INT_REPUTATION_PRESS_FORGIVEN: pressing a ruined reputation back into shape
device_uses.INT_SCANDAL_CENTRIFUGE: separating a scandal into reusable outrage
device_uses.INT_SOUL_FOLDING_TABLE: folding guests' souls neatly for storage
device_uses.INT_WALKER_TANK_TREAD: walking residents about on retired tank treads
device_uses.INT_WINE_THAT_REMEMBERS: a vintage that tells you about the people it was paired with

interactables.$comment: Device kinds for this library's interactive names, tried before library 1's.

loot.$comment: Loot categories for this library's treasure names, tried before library 1's.

setting_pieces.$comment: Setting-specific furniture: for every room template in every setting, three pieces written from the setting's own prose (architecture, furnishing style, technology, decay). Each is an object with its drawing family and placement from the rules; they lead a room's optional furnishings, so a Laundromat's control booth and a Carnival's read differently.
